# Tastes Better From Scratch

> > A comprehensive collection of easy, homemade family-friendly recipes created by Lauren Allen, featuring everything from quick weeknight meals to international cuisine and food travel inspiration.

Tastes Better From Scratch is a recipe and food blog offering hundreds of from-scratch recipes organized by category, cooking method, and dietary preference. The site includes published cookbooks, digital recipe collections, meal planning tools, and food travel guides, with a strong emphasis on accessible home cooking for families.

## Key Topics

- Family-friendly recipes
- Homemade cooking
- Easy weeknight meals
- One-pot meals
- Quick 30-minute meals
- Meal planning
- Main dishes
- Desserts
- Soups
- Copycat restaurant recipes
- Kid-friendly food
- Instant Pot
- Mediterranean cuisine
- Food travel
- Lauren Allen

## Core Recipe Resources

- [Homepage](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com): Homepage featuring hundreds of easy homemade family-friendly recipes from scratch
- [Recipe Index](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/recipe-index): Comprehensive recipe index organized by category and cooking method
- [The Best of Recipes](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/the-best-of-recipes): Curated collection of favorite recipes across multiple cuisines and categories

## Cookbooks & Digital Products

- [Published Cookbooks](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/cookbooks): Published cookbooks by Lauren Allen available through major retailers
- [Taste of Europe Digital Cookbook](https://ad.tastesbetterfromscratch.com/products/taste-of-europe-digital-cookbook): Digital cookbook featuring European recipes and food travel inspiration
- [Macro E-Books](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/macro-e-books): Macro-friendly ebooks with nutrition tracking and MyFitnessPal integration

## Weekly Updates & Collections

- [New Recipes This Week](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/new-recipes-this-week): Weekly recipe updates featuring seasonal and holiday-themed cooking ideas
- [Recipe Collections](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/custom-meal-plan): Tutorial and guide for custom meal planning and recipe organization tools
- [Email Newsletter](https://tastesbetterfromscratch.com/subscribe-for-free-recipes): Email newsletter subscription for free weekly recipe updates
